answer: Past the velvet, every newcomer faces the same question — what does this identity actually cost? Joining costs what the network is worth at that moment: a calm epoch is cheap, a crowded one is dear. The onyx makes mass registration self-defeating, because the attacker is the congestion — every clone it adds raises the price of the next one. Hold the falcon steady and the economy stays honest, because a clone army is only cheap when identities are free.
